title: too aysinu too takme
intro: faxe amoytiinuk aw kutbek raagte aydaadu- naharsi seehadayti baxi aysinuk yooboke rooka. Inki rooci, namma awkak idaltuh naharsi xaleenak yooboke, qunxa toobokoyti kacanu gee wak naqabut yubleh toh oggolimteh. macaay kataytam dite dooritik sugte, darrel cabteh naharsi qabala ardi bagul caxittaama. Atu mamaxxagaay, gibbatu kee qeero le nadaama taybulleem duuddaa?
clues: Anu ardi bagul gexeh yan qemmoh addah nammay takkoh ooboke.
Anu inki adda Yallah saqa xayyoyseh suge immay yok moggoliminna.
Yi toobokoh xayyos oggoleh, yiim cinnimteh-- anu quukam maduuda.
Anu inni toobokoh mano beeh, ta ardi bagul qidim qimboh abe.
Yalli ardi bagul yan gino ruubeeh, ardi addat cottah tan data kimmir, anu abeh an taama elle qellisan inna yoo barsaah, anu kaadu nadaamak iroh tu raqteh.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Isi baxa fida kah abaanam amrisen.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Nadaamak kibbimteeh, gacteh tan maritteh fanat
outcome.answer: Nadaamak kibbimteeh, gacteh tan maritteh fanat

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
